description: This Scala source file defines the class PythonWorkerLogCapture, which manages capturing and routing logs from Python UDF workers in Apache Spark. It handles parsing log lines, managing per-worker log writers, and wrapping input streams to intercept log output.

classes.name: PythonWorkerLogCapture
classes.description: Manages Python UDF log capture and routing to per-worker log writers, including stream wrapping and log line processing.

classes.name: CaptureWorkerLogsInputStream
classes.description: An InputStream wrapper that captures and processes Python UDF logs from an underlying InputStream.

methods.name: wrapInputStream
methods.description: Creates an InputStream wrapper that captures Python UDF logs from the given stream.

methods.name: removeAndCloseWorkerLogWriter
methods.description: Removes and closes the log writer for a specific worker ID.

methods.name: closeAllWriters
methods.description: Closes all active worker log writers.

methods.name: getOrCreateLogWriter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a log writer for a given worker ID.

methods.name: processLogLine
methods.description: Processes a log line from a Python worker, routing logs or closing writers as needed.
